general_theorem.name: NONCONSTANT_BINARY_AFFINE_LOCAL_IMPLICATION_TRANSPORT
general_theorem.map_class: Each target variable v is assigned beta_v = c XOR x_i or beta_v = c XOR x_i XOR x_j with i != j. Constant-only functions are forbidden.
general_theorem.literal_substitution_embedding: Signed literal substitution is the arity-1 special case: x_i corresponds to c=0 and NOT x_i to c=1.
general_theorem.clause_certificate: For each target clause C, after replacing target variables by their affine source functions, require either that C(phi) is a tautology, or that some actual source clause D logically implies C(phi).
general_theorem.verification_cost: For width<=3 source/target CNFs and affine support<=2, D => C(phi) involves at most 9 source variables, so exhaustive local truth-table verification takes at most 2^9 assignments per clause witness and is polynomial overall.
general_theorem.model_transport: If alpha satisfies the source CNF, define beta by evaluating every affine target function under alpha. Every source clause D used as a witness is true under alpha, hence every certified target clause is true under beta. Therefore every source model transports to a target model.
general_theorem.constant_firewall: Constant-only affine target functions are excluded because an all-constant map would simply encode a satisfying assignment of the target and would hide SAT search inside the transport certificate.

critical_instance.safe_deletion: Every model of source sibling A transports to a model of target sibling B, so SAT(A) implies SAT(B). Hence SAT(A) OR SAT(B) iff SAT(B), and A may be deleted.

strictness_certificate.R44BW_fact: Complete enumeration of 100000 signed-literal many-to-one substitutions per direction found zero valid transports.
strictness_certificate.R44BX_fact: The displayed nonconstant binary-affine map gives a valid A->B transport.
strictness_certificate.conclusion: NONCONSTANT_BINARY_AFFINE_TRANSPORT strictly extends the effective safe-deletion power of SIGNED_LITERAL_SUBSTITUTION_TRANSPORT on an exact maxdef-critical instance.

next_exact_question: Determine discovery complexity and critical coverage of the nonconstant binary-affine transport class. First isolate a polynomially discoverable fixed-deviation/fixed-affine-support subclass or prove a generic discovery barrier; separately seek a maxdef-critical pair with no valid binary-affine transport to test universality of the relation itself.
